visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a back view of a woman with a long braid walking outdoors. She wears a beige technical jacket with a pink drawstring and an orange hip bag featuring a white logo. She is walking on a concrete surface next to a boat trailer. (2) She turns around to face the camera, smiling broadly. She wears a beige baseball cap with a blue 'R' logo. Behind her is a large boat with 'Uncle' written in red cursive. The lighting is natural and bright daylight. (3) She bends down toward a green and white plastic cooler. Inside the cooler, large translucent ice blocks are packed around several long, silvery ribbon fish (hairtails). (4) A close-up shot shows the fish in the cooler. She uses a thin black stick or rod to point at the fish as she counts. Various yellow and blue text overlays appear on the screen. (5) A circular visual overlay zooms in on her face as she speaks directly to the camera with an expressive, slightly mischievous smile. In the background, a man wearing a black vest and white clogs walks past a black pickup truck. (6) The video transitions to a pink and black graphic end screen featuring a circular portrait of the woman, a red plus icon, a red checkmark on a 'Like' button, and fall leaves decorations.
